name: @hanzo/skills-site
description: hanzoskills.com — the site published from public/

scripts.build: python3 scripts/build.py && npm run webmcp && python3 scripts/site.py
scripts.webmcp: node --input-type=module -e "import {stripTypeScriptTypes} from 'node:module'; import {readFileSync, writeFileSync} from 'node:fs'; writeFileSync('public/webmcp.js', stripTypeScriptTypes(readFileSync('scripts/webmcp.ts', 'utf8')))"
